title: Grateful Dead Live at Paramount Theater on 1972-07-25
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Stellar soundboard capture of a fiery 1972 set highlighted by an explosive 'The Other One' jam and tight first‑set classics.
ai_review.review: This Charlie Miller board recording delivers a clear, room‑filled mix with hot vocal mics and a slightly low bass that doesn’t detract from the overall impact. The performance is a high‑energy showcase of 1972 Dead brilliance – a scorching 'The Other One' jam, tight Bird Song, powerful Playin’ in the Band and a blazing second set that keeps the audience on fire.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently enthusiastic reviews praise both the musical performance (especially The Other One) and the soundboard recording quality, with only minor technical quibbles.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, room‑filled mix; vocal mics prominent; drums slightly forward. Bass a tad low for some listeners and occasional vocal distortion, plus brief tuning hiccups, but overall a stellar board capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set rolls through tight classics (Bird Song, Cumberland Blues) and builds to a powerful second set; the momentum peaks with an explosive The Other One jam and stays high through Truckin' and the closing numbers.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Leads the intense jams, though noted as out‑of‑tune during parts of Black Throated Wind; overall strong guitar work throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Delivers a monumental bass solo ('bombing' the audience) and prominent vocal contributions, especially on Cumberland Blues and He's Gone.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals sit well in the mix; occasional string break on his guitar noted, with some reviewers wishing his rhythm guitar was louder.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's keyboards are hot and driving during Playin' in the Band; overall keyboard presence praised.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy's drums are mixed a touch higher than usual, providing a solid, energetic backbone.
